title: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out two months early

slides.head: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out two months early
What happened
slides.body: Godavari Superfast, Garib Rath, LTT Visakhapatnam and Visakha Express show REGRET in Sleeper; Gowthami, Cocanada and Narasapur are full or long-waitlisted, per TOI.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Railways open reservations 60 days ahead, and demand for the Sankranthi weekend to AP is far above seats.

slides.head: on AP trains for Jan 9-12
slides.body: SCR runs at least 100 trains between Telangana and AP, yet Jan 9-12 seats are gone; Mumbai, Delhi and Bengaluru trains still have berths.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: SCR operates at least 100 trains connecting Telangana with AP destinations.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: When SCR announces its Sankranthi special trains and extra coaches. Ask: How early will SCR announce Sankranthi specials this year?

captions.instagram:
Sankranthi trains to AP sold out two months early

Popular Secunderabad-Visakhapatnam and Godavari-district trains ran out of tickets minutes after 60-day advance booking opened for Jan 9-12.

Why it matters: Railways open reservations 60 days ahead, and demand for the Sankranthi weekend to AP is far above seats.
